newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU Boeing probe unaffected by FTC decision - source.
newsitem.headline: EU Boeing probe unaffected by FTC decision - source.

text.p: European Commission inquiries into Boeing Co.'s merger with McDonnell Douglas will be unaffected by the U.S. government's decision to clear the deal, a Commission official told Reuters on Tuesday.
"The Commission's own procedures continue as planned," said the official, who asked not to be named.

The U.S. Federal Trade Commission on Tuesday unconditionally approved the $14 billion merger of U.S. aircraft manufacturer Boeing Co. and former rival McDonnell Douglas, helping clear the way for creation of the world's largest aircraft maker.
Commission anti-trust officials are working on their response to a submission provided by Boeing last Monday.

They are due to present their thinking on the case to an advisory committee of EU national competition officials slated to meet next Friday before a final decision by the EU executive itself slated for July 23. -- Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287-6800
